text:
Nora Patel: quick idea 1: run a small "shadow cohort" of private-deploy customers to validate onboarding playbook and private-console telemetry before the full private beta. want to capture ops friction and any data-classification blockers.

Ethan Brooks: sounds good. what's the target size?

Nora Patel: 4 customers max, 6 week engagement each. pick 2 VPC customers and 2 on-prem pilots. goal is to validate: infra checklist, KMS/HSM integration, and audit-log export.

Lena Martinez: gating thoughts: infra readiness (network routes, egress policy ok), infra engineer assigned, legal signoff on data flow, and a basic smoke deploy with test vectors.

Owen Kim: add a quick acceptance matrix for latency/cost expectations. for private we shouldn't promise hosted numbers, but we need baseline targets per-customer. propose: P95 latency < 500ms on demo load, cost estimate within 30% of hosted baseline.

Carlos Vega: QA note: include an automated regression harness that runs nightly on the customer's snapshot dataset. qa-bot can schedule it. also capture prompt-level diffs so partners see quality drift.

qa-bot: Scheduled nightly-regression job for customer sample sets 1719004460-job1. report delivered to partner-channel.

Nora Patel: feedback cadence: weekly async form + one 45m triage call every 2 weeks with infra + product + cs. record calls.

Ethan Brooks: incentives: free private control-plane for 3 months + 2 free capacity boosts during onboarding. user will need to opt-in to telemetry 1 opt-in is required for cohort.

Lena Martinez: compliance customers will push for narrower telemetry. legal-bot: please prepare a short telemetry consent template we can attach to invites.

legal-bot: Draft telemetry consent template created in legal-drive "private-cohort-consent-v1".

Owen Kim: success criteria we can gate on: 1) partner completes smoke deploy within 10 business days; 2) <=1 critical infra incident during onboarding; 3) partner-enabled routes >= 2 by week 6; 4) no quality regression > 3% on eval set.

Carlos Vega: rollback policy: if critical incident or regression threshold breached, pause rollout and schedule hotfix window within 72h. document rollback steps in playbook.

Nora Patel: onboarding playbook rough contents:
- pre-onboard checklist (network, IAM, KMS)
- smoke deploy steps + sample commands
- nightly regression harness + quality diff report
- telemetry consent + data retention notes
- escalation contacts + SLA for infra response
- incentives & contract addendum

Ethan Brooks: timeline: recruit by end of next sprint (2 weeks), run cohorts starting week 4. nominations from AE team due in 4 days.

Lena Martinez: engineering asks: one private-deploy engineer for onboarding per customer (shared), and a small docs pass. Owen, can you confirm headcount?

Owen Kim: can allocate 0.4 FTE per customer from eng-oncall pool for the pilot. opening ticket to secure time.

qa-bot: Created ticket ENG-PRIVATE-27 to reserve eng-oncall allocation.

Nora Patel: action items: 1) Nora draft invite + telemetry consent (due Fri). 2) Ethan collect AE nominations (due in 4 days). 3) Lena assemble smoke vectors and eval set. 4) Owen open resource ticket (ENG-PRIVATE-27). 5) Carlos draft nightly regression config.

Carlos Vega: I'll prototype the nightly diff report and share example in #product-qa by Tue.

Nora Patel: perfect. i'll post the invite draft to #product-drafts and ping legal for consent review. thanks team :rocket:
